description: FREE (key) to hand over — Use when records should go to the CRM, a sequencer or Slack through one of the workspace's pipelines. records of a list shared with you go to one of the workspace's pipelines you may use (describe_list names them: HubSpot, Slack, lemlist …). The pipeline's data check and release apply: a manual one waits for a person; one that sends by itself delivers at once and is PAID per record delivered — describe_list names each pipeline's `credits_per_record`; it counts on this key's day budget. Tell your user records × that price first. Up to 500 per call.
